phases.name: Slice 01 — Graph-first front page: shared engine, intent telemetry, recent-7 list, in-place save repaint (US-010 + US-011, milestone-8)

criteria: GET / with entries renders #home-graph (data-view="trend", data-scale="3M") before the <form>, with the data-lens/data-window control grammar; front page ignores ?view=/?scale= (D-20)
GET /static/graph.js serves the shared engine; both templates load it deferred; graph.html inline chart JS deleted; all shipped graph/theme ATs green unmodified
0 entries → no graph area; entry readiness unchanged: interactive ≤2 s, exactly one autofocus (weight field), no tabindex anywhere, decimal keypad intact (Q4)
sw.js: /static/graph.js joins APP_SHELL AND SHELL_CACHE bumps -v2 → -v3 in this same step/commit (Forge condition 1, Q5)

steps.implementation_notes: ADR-008: extraction only — fetch, grid builders, themed uPlot render, lens/scale state on the mount's data-view/data-scale, matchMedia re-render relocate as-is; both pages configure the module with their mount + initial lens/scale. Mount rendered only when entries exist (existing GET / context already carries entries). theme.css: tokens only, ≥44 px controls, both schemes AA. @pending discipline: unskip only this step's 3 scenarios. Note: ambient /trend fetches still emit trend.view.opened until 01-02 — ATs never execute JS, so no test pollution; deploy happens at slice end. EXEMPT FROM PARADIGM: JS extraction + templates/CSS/sw data, no new Python logic. Compensate with property-based test at integration level on adjacent slot (the entry-primacy @property scenario pins the ≤2 s + focus contract over the served page).

steps.name: Deliberate-study beacon: closed vocabulary, gated, fire-and-forget
steps.description: CREATE POST /telemetry/trend-study behind AccessGate: payload {surface: home|history, control: lens|scale, value: trend|raw|1W|1M|3M|6M|1Y|ALL} → 2xx + exactly one trend.study.interaction append; anything else → 400, no trail write. graph.js fires the beacon on every explicit lens/scale tap on either surface.
criteria: Valid payload → 2xx and exactly one trend.study.interaction append, counted in /stats trend_study_this_week; two front-page taps (scale then lens) count as 2
Unknown or malformed payload → 400, never 500, zero trail writes — no free-text ever reaches the append-only trail (unbounded-preservation)
Unauthenticated beacon → door (303/401), zero trail writes
graph.js beacon is fire-and-forget: network or append failure has zero UI effect; lens toggle still preserves the chosen scale on the front page
append_event failure inside the route swallowed with a structured log; responses only 2xx or 400 (Forge condition 3)
